author: Ari Koslow
title: Juan Soto (back) still being evaluated Wednesday
desc: Mets manager Carlos Mendoza said Juan Soto's back injury is still being evaluated.
impact: Mendoza did not rule out an IL stint for Soto. This will remain a situation to monitor.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Oswaldo Cabrera recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Yankees recalled Oswaldo Cabrera from Triple-A.
impact: Cabrera gets his first opportunity in the majors with Ryan McMahon placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan McMahon (infection) placed on IL
desc: The Yankees placed Ryan McMahon on the 10-day injured list with an ear/throat infection.
impact: McMahon will be down for at least the next week and a half. Oswaldo Cabrera is being recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matthew Boyd (knee) to be activated Thursday
desc: Matthew Boyd will be activated from the injured list and start on Thursday against the Mets.
impact: Boyd has been on the injured list since the beginning of May. He'll be looking to get back on track after struggling over the first month of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kodai Senga to be moved to bullpen
desc: Mets manager Carlos Mendoza said Kodai Senga will be moved to the bullpen.
impact: Senga's struggles on the season continued in Tuesday's loss against the Cubs. The Mets are expected to get Christian Scott back from the injured list this weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Austin Voth designated for assignment
desc: The Twins designated Austin Voth for assignment.
impact: Voth loses his spot on the Twins 40-man roster. He will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kendry Rojas optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Twins optioned Kendry Rojas to Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Rojas allowed one earned run on one hit and three walks while striking out four over two innings in a spot start against the Dodgers. He should get another opportunity at some point later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marco Raya recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Twins recalled Marco Raya from Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Raya gets an opportunity in the majors. He will add a fresh arm in the Twins bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kody Funderburk recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Twins recalled Kody Funderburk from Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Funderburk will step back into a middle-relief role in the Twins bullpen. He has posted a 3.44 ERA with one save across 21 appearances this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Ferguson to be 27th man in doubleheader Wednesday
desc: Tyler Ferguson will serve as the 27th man in Wednesday's doubleheader against the Mets.
impact: Ferguson will add an extra arm in the bullpen for the Cubs for Wednesday's doubleheader.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vince Velasquez called up by Cubs
desc: The Cubs called up Vince Velasquez.
impact: Velasquez will add a fresh arm in the Cubs bullpen with Edward Cabrera placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edward Cabrera (hamstring/adductor) placed on IL
desc: The Cubs placed Edward Cabrera on the 15-day injured list.
impact: Cabrera is getting imaging done on Wednesday in New York. There should be an update on him on a potential timetable to return when the results are returned.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Francisco Lindor (calf) to be activated for Game 2 of doubleheader
desc: Mets manager Carlos Mendoza said Francisco Lindor will be activated for Game 2 of Wednesday's doubleheader.
impact: Lindor is not in the lineup in Game 1. He'll make his return for the second game of the doubleheader from a lengthy absence due to a calf injury.

author: Nate Miller
title: AJ Smith-Shawver (elbow) set for rehab assignment
desc: AJ Smith-Shawver (elbow) is set to begin a rehab assignment on Thursday.
impact: The first step in the plan for Smith-Shawver's rehab process will be to throw between 35 and 40 pitches in a simulated game at the Braves' spring training facility on Thursday. Smith-Shawver last pitched for the Braves on May 29 of last year. The young righty was shut down with an elbow issue after that and ultimately underwent Tommy John surgery. He is on track to return to the Braves at some point after the All-Star break.
